title: Bands' baseball teams and his love of basketball
summary: Bands had informal baseball games; as a kid he loved basketball and complains about the modern rules; he left school in 1923.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Did all bands have baseball teams in those days?

Yeah, back in them days. Well, they didn't call them teams. They would just get together and play some other guys, and some afternoons they'd meet sometimes... You know. But it wasn't called no regular team.

Some of them could play and some couldn't. I couldn't, so I didn't. Too much running is no good for me. However, when I was a kid, I wanted to be a basketball player. Oh, I loved basketball in them days. Nowadays, they've changed basketball around and it's a different thing. Like, when I came along, when they played basketball, when a guy made a basket, they went back to the center and tossed it up to see who gets the ball. They
didn't give it to the other side like what they do here now. So they didn't... The scoring wasn't as high like it is now.
No, that makes it a different game.

Yeah. But I liked it that way. Because I don't think it's fair, a guy makes a basket and then he's got to give it to the other guy so he could make a basket. That's not fair. You should toss up and scramble for the ball. You know, that's the way I think the game should be. I don't care. That's the way I look at it. A guy makes a basket, and they give the other guy the ball. That's no good. That's saying, 'You make it, and now it's my turn to make it, and now it's your turn.' And they do it that way. And nobody gets a chance, you know, to really see how great they are. You know.
When did they change those rules?
Oh, I don't know. Sometime between my school days and today. My school days is way back. The last year I was in school was 1923, you know...
